title: Cancel external dispatch
purpose: Stop an external routing request before any source result has been entered while preserving the completed handoff record.
summary: Cancel an external dispatch before any result has been entered. The handoff record is kept.

tasks.title: Cancel the dispatch
steps: Give the [[Reason]] and select [[Cancel external dispatch]].

tasks.title: Send the test out again
steps: Record a new handoff from the sample. A cancelled subcontract cannot be reused.

good_to_know: Cancelling does not record that containers came back, and does not change the sample's location.
Once any result is entered, the dispatch can no longer be cancelled.
A cancelled dispatch still stops the test from being withdrawn and the collection or matrix from being corrected.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: Cancellation does not assert the containers were physically returned, alter the sample’s current custody location, or delete source/dispatch history. Cancelled dispatch history still prevents collection/matrix rewriting and test withdrawal.

items.label: Sample / Analyte / Client / External laboratory
items.description: Identifies the selected requested-test route being cancelled.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required cancellation explanation, at most 4000 characters.

items.label: Cancel external dispatch
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators record cancellation actor/time/reason and audit, then return to subcontract history. Any source-result history blocks cancellation. A later handoff must create a new subcontract record.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Leaves the form and returns to the subcontract without cancellation.

sections.title: Saving and concurrency
paragraphs: Validation errors keep submitted text on the form. A concurrent subcontract change refuses saving; reload and review its current source history before resubmitting. Cancel returns to the subcontract without changing it. Cancelled dispatches cannot receive source entry/review or further cancellation.
